framework: AWS Security Best Practices + HackTricks Cloud AWS
description: Compute posture checks for ECS/EKS attack surface and persistence indicators

items.title: EventBridge rules trigger ECS tasks on a schedule (persistence indicator)
items.description: Scheduled ECS tasks can be used to maintain persistence or execute unauthorized workloads.
items.remediation: Review EventBridge rules/targets; restrict who can create/update rules and RunTask; monitor for unexpected scheduled executions.

pci_dss.reason: Monitoring scheduled execution changes reduces persistence dwell time.

items.title: ECS task definitions show drift / unexpected containers
items.description: Unexpected containers or task definition changes can indicate backdoored workloads.
items.remediation: Enforce IaC and immutable deployments; restrict RegisterTaskDefinition/UpdateService; review diffs and approvals.

pci_dss.reason: Change control helps prevent unauthorized modifications to workloads.

items.title: ECS workloads lack centralized logging
items.description: Missing logs reduce detection and incident response capabilities.
items.remediation: Enable CloudWatch Logs for ECS tasks/services and enforce logging in task definition baselines.

pci_dss.reason: Logging supports detection of suspicious activity.

items.title: ECS task roles or execution roles appear overly permissive
items.description: Excessive IAM rights assigned to workloads amplify impact of initial access.
items.remediation: Apply least privilege to task roles; use permission boundaries and scope resource ARNs.

pci_dss.reason: Least privilege reduces blast radius of workload compromise.

items.title: EKS cluster endpoint is public without strong restrictions
items.description: Public EKS endpoints expand attack surface and increase likelihood of credential brute/abuse paths.
items.remediation: Disable public endpoint access or restrict CIDRs; enforce private endpoint where possible and use strong auth controls.

pci_dss.reason: Limit inbound access to system components to only authorized sources.

items.title: EKS control-plane logging is not fully enabled
items.description: Missing EKS logging reduces detection for authentication and API misuse.
items.remediation: Enable EKS control plane logs (api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, scheduler) and ship to centralized SIEM.

pci_dss.reason: Audit logs provide visibility into administrative access and security events.

notes: Compute skill is scoped to ECS/EKS in the selected region. Evidence must remain passive (no active exploitation).
